name: Bleeding Diathesis Due to Integrin Alpha2-Beta1 Deficiency

criteria.description: Presence of mucocutaneous bleeding symptoms such as epistaxis or menorrhagia
Demonstration of impaired platelet adhesion to collagen in platelet function assays
Identification of pathogenic variants in ITGA2 or ITGB1 genes encoding integrin alpha2-beta1
Exclusion of other inherited or acquired platelet function disorders

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (clinical bleeding, platelet function impairment, and genetic confirmation) must be met for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, laboratory, and genetic findings due to rarity and phenotypic overlap with other platelet function disorders.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mucocutaneous bleeding with prolonged bleeding time
searchTerms: bleeding from skin and mucous membranes with slow clotting
mucocutaneous bleeding with prolonged bleeding time
extended bleeding in mucous membranes and skin
platelets don't stick well to collagen

common.symptomName: Prolonged bleeding after minor cuts or dental procedures
searchTerms: bleeding longer after small cuts or dental work
small red spots on arms and legs
bleeding that lasts long after surgery

laboratory: Prolonged bleeding time with normal platelet count
Impaired platelet aggregation response to collagen
imaging: Neuroimaging may reveal intracranial hemorrhage in severe cases
genetic: Pathogenic variants in ITGA2 or ITGB1 genes confirmed by molecular testing
other: Flow cytometry showing reduced or absent integrin alpha2-beta1 expression on platelets

distinguishingFeatures: Deficiency of integrin alphaIIb-beta3 rather than alpha2-beta1
Severe platelet aggregation defects with multiple agonists

redFlags: Severe mucocutaneous bleeding unresponsive to standard hemostatic measures
Intracranial hemorrhage or other life-threatening bleeding
Family history of unexplained bleeding diathesis
references: Nurden AT. Platelet collagen receptors: their structure, function and role in disease. Thromb Haemost. 2007;98(1):1-7.
Kunicki TJ, Nugent DJ. Platelet integrin alpha2beta1: a collagen receptor in health and disease. Blood. 2014;124(8):1233-1241.
